svg.text: Database structure and Power BI semantic model
A POSTGRESQL STRUCTURE | aviation_bi / aviation | 7 source-aligned tables
No primary keys or foreign keys are declared. Shared labels do not establish a relational join or common population.
B POWER BI SEMANTIC MODEL | 22 tables | 35 relationships | Import mode
Each mapping below is dimension (1) -> imported fact/view (*), with one-way filtering. Database foreign keys are not implied.
Solid mapping = active. The closure end-date mapping is inactive. Origin and destination roles and severity vocabularies are separate.
ACTIVE -> aviation vw_airspace_closure (*) . Closure Start Date
INACTIVE -> aviation vw_airspace_closure (*) . Closure End Date
Disconnected: Report Measures (33 measures) and Operational Factor (airport / airspace exposure selector).
Lineage: seven CSV datasets -> seven PostgreSQL tables -> SQL interfaces or direct fact imports -> Power BI dimensions and measures.
Financial populations are undated. Date filters use record dates; airspace uses closure start dates and whole closure durations.
Static simulated portfolio case study. No direct fact-to-fact joins. No combined deduplicated airport-plus-airspace flight total.
Source: repository DDL, PBIP TMDL and relationship metadata. Snapshot reviewed on 1 October 2026.
